carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible as multiple parallel longitudinal ridges on the dorsal surface, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with high-intensity highlights along the superior crests and shadowed regions directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin occupies a significant portion of the foreground, displaying a pattern of high-luminance circular spots and vertical striations, subject to optical distortion from surface refraction.
